decisions.rationale: User: too much review-wizard UI for v1. Algorithm itself is validated (spike 001) — revive later; only the 4-step wizard is the cost.

decisions.decision: KEEP 006 (cutouts) and 008 (live-readout) — user judged both great additions
decisions.rationale: Both de-risked; cutouts is the signature feature with math already proven exact

decisions.decision: 006 circle-cutout precise-center method = 3-POINT circle (reuse shipped solveCircle, spike-003, ~1e-10); 2-POINT (diameter) also viable; store a perfect circle as a {cx,cy,r} primitive → area = pi*r^2 exact; report inside diameter = 2r
decisions.rationale: 3-point derives the exact center from rim points you can see, so the 'exact center' problem dissolves. Caveat: snapping (spike 002) is markup-to-markup, NOT raster-edge — no auto edge-grab on the scan; place points by eye at zoom.

decisions.decision: 008 readout = passive live 'see-it' (AutoCAD Dynamic Input style); consider ALSO PlanSwift-style 'type-it-exact' per-segment entry (their 'Verify Points')
decisions.rationale: Web-verified: PlanSwift's documented mechanism is Verify Points (type/adjust exact length per click), not a confirmed always-on floating tooltip. The two ideas are complementary and cheap since 008 proved the readout is free to compute.
